text:
Maya Chen: Opening a PR to consolidate model-card migration snippets: limits, bench links, and SDK examples. PR #4593 :clipboard:
Samir Gupta: Which models are in scope? especially quantized variants.
Maya Chen: Nebula3b, ZephyrX, Polaris13b, Aurora-lite3b. I'll add a small compatibility matrix in the PR.
Lin Zhao: For Nebula3b include the embed sharding sample and a chunked-batching SDK snippet:
```python
from redwood.client import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
for chunk in chunks(text, 1024):
    emb = client.embeddings.create(model="nebula3b-embed-shard", input=chunk)
```
Samir Gupta: Also add a short note differentiating advertised token limit vs effective usable context for Polaris13b. Many users conflate them.
Maya Chen: I'll add a table: advertised limit | recommended safe limit | common pitfalls.
Nate R: I found dead bench anchors on ZephyrX. Can we add canonical anchors to prevent rot?
Maya Chen: Yes 14 I'll add a stable anchor and redirect: /models/zephyrx#benchmarks -> /models/zephyrx#bench-stable.
Devex: Use new import path (redwood.client) in snippets and add a snippet-smoke CI job note in PR checklist.
Maya Chen: Updated examples and checklist.
Samir Gupta: For quantized variants include latency tradeoffs and our runtime's fallback policy (when it'll route to a bigger variant or CPU).
Maya Chen: Adding a Compatibility blurb linking to routing policy.
Lin Zhao: Add a failure example for long sequences: KV cache cold miss causing ~2x slowdown. Include real numbers for Aurora-lite3b (4k->8k test: ~1.8x latency on cold cache).
Maya Chen: I'll paste the benchmark results in the PR.
Docs Bot: PR #4593 opened by Maya Chen 14 reviewers: @Lin Zhao, @Samir Gupta, @Devex.
Nate R: Move examples file to examples/nebula/embed_sharding.md and add redirects so old links still work.
Maya Chen: Done in the branch.
Samir Gupta: Add a short "For integrators" migration note about shard keys and deduping when merging shards.
Maya Chen: Adding paragraph + deterministic shard-key code sample.
Devex: Ping me in the PR and I9ll wire the smoke test.
Maya Chen: Aim to merge by EOD after Lin's unit test lands.
Lin Zhao: I'll add the Nebula3b embed chunking unit test shortly.
Docs Bot: PR #4593 status 14 ready for review. (2 approvals required)
Maya Chen: Merging after unit test. Will follow up with a link map.
Docs Bot: PR #4593 merged by Maya Chen 14 changes deployed to staging docs.
Nate R: Quick smoke looks good: bench links resolve, snippets render.
Maya Chen: Closing loop 14 I added a short "model-card migration playbook" in the internal playbooks with checklist items (https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/playbooks/card-migration).
